title: Route
description: The visiting order a van follows. PRD-2 section 3.3.

wardIds.description: THE VISITING ORDER. The ETA sums the straight-line distances from the van through the remaining wards IN THIS ORDER. Reordering this array silently changes every ETA and alerts the wrong ward.

scheduledStartTime.description: Shown to the user app when no van is on shift. HH:mm.
